title: Find Any Window Element Your Way -- grap Multi-Modal Search
desc: grap = glob/regex/OR/UIA-scope/JSON5 multi-field AND. Wildcards: *Button*. OR: *notepad*;*calc*. UIA scope: app#panel. Tab portal: Chrome#ChatGPT#model. JSON5: {title:'Claude',domain:'claude.ai'}. hwnd: *hwnd=001A0F2C*. adb: adb://device/*screen*#balance. Combine: *order*#account = grap inside UIA scope.
steps: grap is a multi-modal pattern: glob wildcards (*Button*), OR via semicolon (*notepad*;*calc*), UIA scope via #panel (app#realtime-account), tab portal (Chrome#ChatGPT#model), JSON5 ({title:'Claude',domain:'claude.ai'}), and direct hwnd:0xNNN.

Combine forms with AND semantics: *order*#account means a window matching '*order*' globally then narrowed to UIA element 'account' inside it. Multi-field JSON5 acts as AND across keys (proc + domain + title).
Adb scheme adb://device/*screen*#balance routes the same syntax to an Android device tree. The 'a11y find' command prints '# TARGET hwnd:0x...' as the first line for copy-paste reuse.

OR INTERNALS + --all PATTERN (2026-05-18): ; OR uses coverage-sum ranking (same SkillCoverageScore as skill search). A window matching MORE of your ; patterns scores HIGHER -- not just first-match. Combine with --all for true fan-out: 'wkappbot a11y invoke "A;B;C" --all' invokes every matched button across all windows in one call. Verified: {proc:'nkrunlite'}#*[0156]*;{proc:'nkrunlite'}#*[0150]* returns 11 TARGETS. One-shot multi-popup dismiss pattern: join all target patterns with ; then invoke --all.
